denominator_definitions.comparable_scope: Both contest cue conditions plus the positive region of each loyalty battery. This subset overlaps the full ordinary summary and must not be added to it.
denominator_definitions.target_response_fields: One disclosure verdict for one response and one requested target.
denominator_definitions.unique_response_evaluations: Model, battery, scenario, and sample identify one response evaluation. Two contest targets share a response. These are not independent experiments or deduplicated text strings.

ordinary_disclosure_summary.count_warning: Field evaluations include two target labels on the same response and repeated samples within scenarios. They are not independent experiments.

historical_audits: The v2 inventory preserves historical single-vendor interrogation, forced-choice, and adaptive audit evidence. None tests these eight corrected blocked pairs.
limitations: These are frozen judge measurements. The blind calibration references are assistant judgments, not human gold.
The prospective sample has 96 negative disclosure references and no positive disclosure references. Positive disclosure sensitivity is unmeasured.
Against-user references are uncertain in 43 of 96 calibration cases. Binary agreement excludes these unresolved references.
Joint served-and-against-user sensitivity is 7/11 among definite comparisons. The clean base has 0/3 detections, single-vendor models 4/5, and pair models 3/3.
The small calibration strata show model-dependent detection. They do not quantify judge bias in these blocked models or validate causal harm comparisons.
The calibration sample has no wrong-direction or rival-leaning cases. Those gate regions lack direct prospective calibration coverage.
The 95% envelopes are pointwise. No multiplicity correction or judge-error correction applies. An interval that includes zero does not establish equivalence.
Missing and uncertain labels retain the complete planned denominator. Missing evidence need not be random.
Each scenario has eight generated samples. Whole-family or whole-scenario resampling preserves their dependence. Seeds remain separate; two seeds do not establish broad replication.
Ordinary disclosure labels do not establish private intentions, truthful training explanations, or resistance to interrogation and adaptive audits.
The composite served-and-against-user event is separate from disclosure. The reports provide no three-way secrecy conjunction.
positive_labels_status: Unblinded aggregate judge labels. No new independent adjudication or raw evidence review was performed.
scope: New corrected blocked pairs only. Earlier six central pairs remain a separate cohort. This update does not replace historical interrogation or audit records.
unique_positive_count_basis: Loyalty has one requested target per saved response. Contest has exactly one positive target label across all blocked responses. Thus the aggregate totals identify 39 distinct response evaluations with any positive label.
